content.overview: Section 22 permits the parties to agree on the language or languages to be used in arbitral proceedings; failing agreement, the tribunal determines the language.
content.glance: Section 22 permits the parties to agree on the language or languages to be used in arbitral proceedings; failing agreement, the tribunal determines the language.
content.study:
Module 1: Party agreement
The parties may determine the language of the proceedings.

Module 2: Tribunal determination
If there is no agreement, the tribunal determines the language and the determination ordinarily applies to the written statements, hearings and award within the statutory framework.

Module 3: Fairness
Language decisions should be applied consistently with equal treatment and a meaningful opportunity to present the case.

examples.body: Parties agree that English will be the procedural language and the tribunal applies that agreement.

examples.body: A language decision effectively prevents one party from understanding or presenting its case without procedural accommodation.
